title: build a poidh app for wedgie
description:
the ask is simple: build a working poidh app for [wedgie](https://wedgie.dev/), the open-source pocket computer and hardware signer.

we want people to be able to browse live poidh bounties right from their wedgie!

## requirements

your app should:

- display live bounties from poidh across Ethereum, Base, and Arbitrum
- let users browse bounties using wedgie's joystick and buttons
- display bounty titles, ETH rewards, descriptions, and other relevant details
- let users view existing claims on a bounty
- have a functional, usable interface designed for wedgie's 240×240 screen
- use real poidh data, not hardcoded examples or mock bounties

wedgie doesn't have native internet connectivity, so using a connected computer as a bridge to retrieve poidh data is perfectly acceptable.

## resources

- poidh: https://poidh.xyz
- poidh GitHub: https://github.com/picsoritdidnthappen/poidh-app
- poidh documentation: https://poidh.xyz/docs
- wedgie: https://wedgie.dev
- wedgie app development guide: https://wedgie.dev/code
- wedgie starter repo: https://github.com/clawdbotatg/wedgie-starter
- Virtual wedgie: https://wedgie.dev/virtual
- wedgie agent instructions: https://wedgie.dev/skill.md

wedgie has extensive documentation specifically designed for AI agents, plus a virtual emulator that allows you to develop and test apps without owning physical hardware.

## submitting a claim

your submission must include:

1. a public GitHub repository containing your complete, open-source app
2. a video demonstrating the app working, either on a physical wedgie or in the virtual emulator
3. clear instructions for installing and running your app, including any companion software required for fetching live data

your claim should not be the video, use a screenshot from the video as your claim

your claim description also does not need to contain all submission info, feel free to simply list your GitHub repo URL

you do not need to own a physical wedgie to participate, but your app should be designed to run on real wedgie hardware.

## choosing a winner

the first wedgie poidh app that Austin himself verifies is legit and covers all the requirements above wins 🏆

winningClaim.title: poidh app for wedgie (Swift Bot Labs)
winningClaim.description:
Repo (app + bridge + install/run instructions): https://github.com/swiftbotlab/wedgie-poidh
Video on the virtual wedgie: https://github.com/swiftbotlab/wedgie-poidh/blob/main/media/poidh-wedgie-demo.mp4

Live poidh bounties on Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum. Joystick to browse and switch chains, green to open a bounty (title, ETH reward, USD, issuer, age, full description), then its claims, then one claim. Red goes back and grey reloads. Built for the 240x240 screen. The data is real: a stdlib Python bridge reads poidh.xyz/bounties/data and the claims API, and talks to the wedgie over USB serial, or to the virtual wedgie via a small link script. Install from wedgie.dev/connect with "Apps from a GitHub repo": swiftbotlab/wedgie-poidh. MIT, by Swift Bot Labs.
